'''Fleet Group ''Stalwart''''' was one of several [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] battle groups present for the [[Battle of Borosk (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Borosk]] fought during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. It included the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Stalwart (Star Destroyer)|''Stalwart'']] and attempted to destroy a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[yammosk]] during the early part of the battle.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant" />
